relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Active caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 into their mature proinflammatory forms and also cleaves gasdermin D (GSDMD).

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, extranuclear HMGB1 released from damaged neurons binds to TLR4 and activates NF-κB signaling to transcriptionally upregulate NLRP3 [50].

relationships.subject: sevoflurane
relationships.evidence_quote: Sevoflurane-induced caspase-1 dependent GSDMD cleavage in BV2 microglia, an effect abolished by NLRP3 or caspase-1 knockout [54].

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: The P2X4R pathway facilitates ATP-dependent calcium influx and upregulates the Kv1.3 potassium channel, thereby enhancing inflammasome assembly [50–52, 72].

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome mediates sevoflurane neurotoxicity in AD and POCD but sevoflurane can suppress NLRP3 in ischemia and neuropathic pain.
Triggers include mitochondrial dysfunction, ROS, impaired autophagy, HMGB1-TLR4 and BBB breakdown.
